cues.en: Between Mach 0.8 and mach 1.2 is what’s known as the transonic range.

cues.zh: 在这些速度下，飞机周围的气流并非完全亚音速或超音速。
cues.en: At these speeds, the airflow around an airplane is not fully subsonic or supersonic.

cues.zh: 本质上，一部分空气是亚音速的，一部分是超音速的。
cues.en: Essentially, some air is subsonic and some is supersonic.

cues.zh: 所以从马赫0.8开始，部分气流变成超音速，阻力呈指数级增加，
cues.en: So beginning at mach 0.8, some airflow becomes supersonic which increases drag exponentially
